_note: 책 QR 보너스 연습 — 안티 작성 · Claude 검토

cards.en: We are recruiting [target]. (announcing open recruitment)
Anyone who is interested in [field]. (defining eligibility)
We hope for many people's participation. (standard closing invitation)
Anyone is welcome. (open welcoming formula)
Please apply. (polite request to register)
Looking for people to join together. (invitation formula)
Closed on a first-come, first-served basis. (deadline condition)
Please contact us. (contact request)

quiz.q: Which sentence ending is standard for a formal recruitment notice in TOPIK Q51?
quiz.why: In TOPIK Q51 formal notice writing, the deferential imperative formula -(으)시기 바랍니다 is the most polite and appropriate ending.

quiz.q: Fill in the blank for a club recruitment notice: '한국 문화를 함께 배우실 분을 ___.'
quiz.why: Recruitment notices directed to readers must use the deferential -ㅂ/습니다 style (찾습니다).

quiz.q: Which phrase is typically used to state eligibility for joining a club?
quiz.why: '누구나 참여할 수 있습니다' (Anyone can participate) is the standard formula indicating open qualification.

quiz.q: Which sentence ending is inappropriately informal for a club invitation bulletin board in Q51?
quiz.why: 연락 주세요 uses informal 해요체; in Q51 announcement writing, deferential style like 연락 주시기 바랍니다 is required.

quiz.q: In the sentence '관심이 있으신 분은 아래 번호로 ___', which closing fits best?
quiz.why: An invitation notice politely prompts the reader to get in touch using 연락 주시기 바랍니다.

fill.q: 이번 독서 모임에 함께 활동하실 분을 찾고 ___.
fill.en: We are looking for people to join activities in this reading club.

fill.q: 사진 촬영에 관심이 있는 분이라면 누구나 환영___.
fill.en: Anyone interested in photography is welcome.

fill.q: 참여를 원하시는 분은 이번 주 금요일까지 신청해 주시기 ___.
fill.en: Those who wish to participate, please apply by this Friday.

fill.q: 인원이 차면 조기에 선착순으로 마감___.
fill.en: If capacity is filled, it will close early on a first-come, first-served basis.

fill.q: 자세한 일정이 궁금하시면 아래 번호로 연락 주시기 ___.
fill.en: If you are curious about the detailed schedule, please contact the number below.

cards.en: Selling [item]. (announcing sale)
Giving away for free. (giving away item)
Used cleanly. (describing good condition of item)
Giving to whoever needs it. (giveaway recipient formula)
I lost [item]. (lost item notice)
Whoever saw it, please contact me. (request for lost item help)
I will give a small reward. (promising reward for return)
I prefer in-person direct transaction. (transaction preference)

quiz.q: In a second-hand sale post, which expression describes that an item is almost new?
quiz.why: '거의 새것입니다' (almost like new) indicates that the item has been kept in excellent condition.

quiz.q: Which ending is appropriate when asking someone to return a lost wallet in Q51?
quiz.why: When writing a formal lost-and-found request, the polite formula -(으)시기 바랍니다 is expected.

quiz.q: What does '소정의 사례를 하겠습니다' mean in a lost property notice?
opts: I will sell it for a low price.
I will offer a token reward to the finder.
I will buy a new item.
I will report to the police.
quiz.why: 사례를 하다 means to give a reward or token of gratitude for returning lost property.

quiz.q: Which sentence has an awkward register for a public notice board selling furniture in Q51?
quiz.why: Imperative 반말 '가져가라' is rude and unacceptable; deferential style like 가져가시기 바랍니다 is required.

quiz.q: Fill in the blank: '이사 때문에 사용하던 전자레인지를 저렴하게 ___.'
quiz.why: Second-hand marketplace posts in Q51 require deferential polite ending 팝니다.

fill.q: 유학을 마치고 귀국하게 되어 책상과 의자를 무료로 나눔___.
fill.en: Because I am returning home after finishing study abroad, I am giving away a desk and chair for free.

fill.q: 구입한 지 세 달밖에 안 되어 상태가 거의 새것과 ___.
fill.en: It has been only three months since purchase, so the condition is like new.

fill.q: 어제 저녁 열람실에서 검은색 지갑을 잃어___.
fill.en: Yesterday evening in the reading room, I lost my black wallet.

fill.q: 제 지갑을 보셨거나 보관하고 계신 분은 꼭 연락 주시기 ___.
fill.en: If you saw or are keeping my wallet, please be sure to contact me.

fill.q: 물건의 부피가 커서 직접 가지러 오실 수 있는 분을 ___.
fill.en: Because the item is bulky, I am looking for someone who can come pick it up in person.

cards.en: We make an announcement. (opening formula for public notices)
Please avoid any confusion in use. (reminder for schedule/rule change)
We ask for your generous understanding. (asking for patience during disruption)
Service is temporarily suspended. (announcing downtime)
Operated normally. (announcing resumption of service)
Please cooperate actively. (requesting compliance)
We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience. (apology formula)
Please check the schedule in advance. (advising advance verification)

quiz.q: Which fixed formula is most appropriate when apologizing for inconvenience caused by facility maintenance?
quiz.why: '불편을 드려 대단히 죄송합니다' (We apologize for the inconvenience) is the standard formula in maintenance notices.

quiz.q: What does '이용에 착오 없으시기 바랍니다' mean in an operating hours change announcement?
opts: Please do not use the facility.
Please check the schedule so there is no mistake or confusion.
quiz.why: This phrase advises users to take note of changes so that no confusion or scheduling mistake occurs.

quiz.q: Which expression politely requests the reader's understanding when a service must be stopped temporarily?
quiz.why: '너그러운 양해 부탁드립니다' (We ask for your kind understanding) is the standard polite request formula.

quiz.q: Fill in the blank: '정기 점검 작업으로 인해 도서관 이용이 일시적으로 ___.'
quiz.why: Public facility announcements in Q51 use deferential passive phrasing (중단됩니다).

quiz.q: Which sentence is appropriate as the opening line of an official building notice?
quiz.why: '입주민 여러분께 안내 말씀 드립니다' is the respectful, standard opening for official notices.

fill.q: 시설 보수 공사로 인하여 이번 주말 엘리베이터 운행이 일시 ___.
fill.en: Due to facility repair work, elevator operation will be temporarily suspended this weekend.

fill.q: 공사 기간 동안 다소 불편하시더라도 주민 여러분의 깊은 양해 ___.
fill.en: Even if it is somewhat inconvenient during construction, we ask for residents' deep understanding.

fill.q: 다음 주 월요일부터는 모든 시설이 정상적으로 운영될 ___.
fill.en: Starting next Monday, all facilities are scheduled to operate normally.

fill.q: 도서관 개관 시간이 변경되오니 이용에 착오 없으시기 ___.
fill.en: As library opening hours change, we hope there will be no confusion in use.

fill.q: 이용자 여러분께 불편을 끼쳐 드려 진심으로 죄송___.
fill.en: We sincerely apologize for causing inconvenience to our users.

cards.ko: 문의 드릴 것이 있어 글을 씁니다
cards.en: I write because I have an inquiry. (standard opening for inquiry email/post)
I would like to know if it is possible to [action]. (polite indirect question)
I would be grateful if you could let me know. (deferential conditional request)
Please reply promptly. (request for response)
I inquire whether registration is possible. (honorific inquiry with 여쭤보다)
I intend to apply for [course/event]. (stating application intention)
Can I change the schedule? (direct polite question)
Please check and verify. (request for confirmation)

quiz.q: Which formula is the most polite and natural way to ask for information in an inquiry post in Q51?
quiz.why: '알려 주시면 감사하겠습니다' (I would be grateful if you let me know) is the standard polite request formula in Q51 writing.

quiz.q: How do you honorifically express 'I am asking you' when writing to an office or teacher?
quiz.why: 여쭤보다 is the humble/honorific verb for 묻다 (to ask), used when inquiring to someone respected.

quiz.q: Which sentence ending appropriately closes an application inquiry email asking for a reply?
quiz.why: '빠른 답변 부탁드립니다' (Please reply promptly) is the standard deferential closing in formal inquiries.

quiz.q: Fill in the blank: '개인 사정으로 수업 시간을 변경할 수 있는지 여쭤보고 ___.'
quiz.why: The writer expresses their polite desire to ask using deferential -고 싶습니다.

quiz.q: Which phrase states an intention to sign up for a training course?
quiz.why: '-(으)려고 합니다' expresses the writer's goal or intention to register for the course.

fill.q: 외국인 장학금 신청 자격에 대해 몇 가지 문의 드릴 것이 ___.
fill.en: I have a few things to inquire about regarding eligibility for the foreign student scholarship.

fill.q: 다음 주 시험 일정을 부득이하게 변경할 수 있는지 알고 ___.
fill.en: I would like to know if it is possible to change next week's exam schedule unavoidably.

fill.q: 신청 서류가 제대로 접수되었는지 확인해 주시면 ___.
fill.en: I would be grateful if you could check whether my application documents were received properly.

fill.q: 바쁘시겠지만 시간 나실 때 확인하시고 빠른 답변 ___.
fill.en: Though you may be busy, please check when you have time and reply promptly.

fill.q: 이번 겨울 방학 한국어 고급 회화 강좌를 신청___ 합니다.
fill.en: I intend to apply for the advanced Korean conversation course this winter vacation.

cards.en: The reason is because [clause]. (standard cause explanation in Q52)
Becomes the cause of [result]. (causal factor formula)
Such a phenomenon appears. (describing an observed result)
Results differ depending on [variable]. (conditional variation)
Plays an important role. (explaining function/mechanism)
Due to this, a problem occurs. (consequence description)
Because temperature rises. (plain-form causal explanation)
Can maintain balance. (mechanism explanation)

quiz.q: Which ending is mandatory for explaining reasons in TOPIK Q52 (written explanatory prose)?
quiz.why: In TOPIK Q52, texts are written strictly in plain form (해라체/-(느)ㄴ다체), so '-기 때문이다' is the required ending.

quiz.q: When a sentence starts with '그 이유는', how must the sentence end?
quiz.why: '그 이유는' (The reason is...) must grammatically match with the causal ending '~기 때문이다' (because...).

quiz.q: Which sentence ending violates the style rule of TOPIK Q52?
quiz.why: 쉬워요 uses informal spoken 해요체; in Q52 written expository essays, plain form (쉽다) must be used.

quiz.q: Fill in the blank: '바람이 불면 체감 온도가 낮아지는 이유는 바람이 땀을 증발시키___.'
quiz.why: In Q52, the sentence explaining a reason ending must take plain form '-기 때문이다'.

quiz.q: What plain form corresponds to '변화해요' in expository Q52 writing for the verb 변화하다?
quiz.why: Action verbs ending in vowels take -ㄴ다 in plain form (변화하다 -> 변화한다).

fill.q: 겨울철에 피부가 쉽게 건조해지는 이유는 실내 공기가 건조하___.
fill.en: The reason skin easily dries up in winter is because indoor air is dry.

fill.q: 식물이 햇빛을 받지 못하면 광합성을 할 수 없어서 성장이 멈추___.
fill.en: If plants cannot receive sunlight, they cannot photosynthesize, so growth stops.

fill.q: 운동을 꾸준히 하면 체력이 증진될 뿐만 아니라 스트레스도 줄어___.
fill.en: Exercising steadily not only improves stamina but also reduces stress.

fill.q: 수면이 부족해지면 뇌세포의 활동이 둔화되어 집중력이 떨어지___.
fill.en: When sleep is insufficient, brain cell activity slows, so concentration drops.

fill.q: 낮과 밤의 기온 차이가 심해지는 이유는 일교차가 크___.
fill.en: The reason temperature difference between day and night becomes severe is because the diurnal range is large.

cards.en: Has a positive influence on [topic]. (stating positive impact)
Gives negative influence to [topic]. (stating negative impact)
Has the effect of preventing [issue]. (preventive effect)
Helps in enhancing memory. (beneficial function)
Can reduce fatigue. (mitigating adverse state)
There is a risk of harming health. (warning of negative consequence)
Improves learning ability. (enhancing capability)
Significantly increases work efficiency. (raising productivity)

quiz.q: Which plain form expression means 'exerts a great influence on health' in Q52?
quiz.why: In Q52, statements are formulated in the plain form: 미치다 + -ㄴ다 -> 미친다.

quiz.q: Which ending correctly completes '비타민 C는 감기를 예방하는 데 ___' in Q52 plain form?
quiz.why: The plain form ending -ㄴ다 (도움을 준다) matches the expository tone required in Q52.

quiz.q: What does '효과를 기대할 수 있다' mean in an article about a new study method?
opts: One can expect positive effects or results.
quiz.why: '효과를 기대할 수 있다' means positive effects or outcomes can be anticipated.

quiz.q: Which word appropriately completes: '스마트폰을 밤늦게 사용하면 수면 장애를 ___'?
quiz.why: 유발할 수 있다 ('can cause/induce') in plain form describes potential adverse consequences.

quiz.q: Which sentence has an INCORRECT ending for Q52 expository prose?
quiz.why: 해 줘요 is spoken 해요체; in Q52, plain form (해 준다) must be used.

fill.q: 규칙적인 유산소 운동은 심혈관 건강에 긍정적인 영향을 ___.
fill.en: Regular aerobic exercise exerts a positive influence on cardiovascular health.

fill.q: 충분한 수분 섭취는 체내 노폐물을 원활하게 배출하는 데 큰 도움을 ___.
fill.en: Sufficient water intake gives great help in smoothly expelling bodily wastes.

fill.q: 자연광을 쬐면 멜라토닌 분비가 조절되어 밤에 깊은 잠을 잘 수 ___.
fill.en: Getting sunlight regulates melatonin secretion, so one can sleep deeply at night.

fill.q: 과도한 카페인 섭취는 불안감을 유발하고 심장 박동을 빠르게 만들 수 ___.
fill.en: Excessive caffeine intake can induce anxiety and make heartbeats fast.

fill.q: 녹차에 들어 있는 성분은 노화를 억제하고 염증을 완화하는 효과가 ___.
fill.en: Ingredients contained in green tea have the effect of suppressing aging and soothing inflammation.

cards.en: On the other hand, another aspect also exists. (introducing contrasting side)
Unlike [clause], there is a difference. (contrast with 달리)
Rather, it can produce an adverse effect. (warning of unintended outcome)
One must be especially careful not to [action]. (caution formula)
While there are advantages, there are also disadvantages. (balanced contrast)
Cannot be viewed as unconditionally good. (critical counterargument)
In contrast to this, a different result appears. (transition connector)
If excessive, it can be harmful. (conditional caution)

quiz.q: Which transition word in Q52 indicates contrast between two opposing situations?
quiz.why: '반면에' (on the other hand) is the standard connector used to introduce an opposing or contrasting perspective.

quiz.q: Fill in the blank for a contrastive sentence: '낮에는 기온이 높지만 밤에는 ___ 기온이 떨어진다.'
quiz.why: '반대로' (conversely) or '반면에' appropriately contrasts the warm daytime with the cold nighttime.

quiz.q: Which phrase serves as a formal caution against side effects in Q52 plain form?
quiz.why: '-아야/어야 한다' is the standard plain form expressing obligation or necessity in expository essays.

quiz.q: What nuance does '오히려 역효과를 낳을 수 있다' express?
opts: Contrary to expectation, it may produce an adverse, opposite result.
It was intended from the beginning.
quiz.why: 오히려 ('on the contrary') combined with 역효과 ('adverse effect') highlights an unintended negative backlash.

quiz.q: Which sentence ending is inappropriately casual for Q52?
quiz.why: 피해야 해 uses casual 반말; in Q52 expository prose, plain form (피해야 한다) is mandatory.

fill.q: 도시 생활은 편리한 ___ 환경오염과 소음 문제가 심각하다.
fill.en: City life is convenient, while pollution and noise problems are serious.

fill.q: 긍정적인 기대와는 달리 과도한 사용은 오히려 독이 될 수 ___.
fill.en: Unlike positive expectations, excessive use can rather become poison.

fill.q: 이 약은 효능이 뛰어나지만 과다 복용하지 않도록 각별히 주의해야 ___.
fill.en: This medicine has excellent efficacy, but one must be especially careful not to overdose.

fill.q: 과거에는 정보 습득이 어려웠던 것과 달리 현대에는 정보가 넘쳐___.
fill.en: Unlike the past when acquiring information was difficult, information overflows in modern times.

fill.q: 스트레스가 적당하면 동기 부여가 되지만 지나치면 건강을 해칠 수 ___.
fill.en: If stress is moderate it provides motivation, but if excessive it can harm health.
